rows: GCCs in India now employ roughly 2.4 million professionals, with 2025 the most active GCC year on record. Hiring here increasingly skews toward AI, cloud, platform engineering, and SRE roles rather than routine coding.
India IT hiring is projected to grow around 7% in FY27, alongside a "twin hiring pattern": targeted hiring in advanced skills and quiet rationalization in legacy, routine roles.
AI-capable professionals in Indian IT command salaries 18-43% higher than peers without those skills, and AI/ML now makes up a far larger share of tech job postings than three years ago.

items.text: AI tools now write a large share of routine, boilerplate code, so the "easy" entry tasks juniors used to learn on are shrinking.

items.heading: India Produces Roughly 1
items.text: India produces roughly 1.5 million engineering graduates a year, and CS/IT is the most oversubscribed branch of all of them.

items.heading: Tcs Alone Cut Over 12,000
items.text: TCS alone cut over 12,000 roles in 2025, mostly at middle and senior levels, as part of a broader "workforce rationalization" trend across services firms.

items.text: At the same time, GCCs, product companies, and AI-adjacent teams are hiring aggressively for higher-skill roles.
